# ToolCall

Tool call pill rows, grouped into a surface card.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.ToolCall` · 12 Thread

## Use

```jsx

```


## Notes

Tool calls (web/src Transcript.tsx). ToolCall: 32px pill row (caret · icon · name · mono args · duration/loader/error) with a hover wash; opens to a 12px-radius mono pre. ToolCalls: groups 2+ calls in a 20px-radius surface card with a 40px "N tool calls · names" header that expands. The caret rotates with the settle spring.
